paper_metadata.title: Effect of nano-WC reinforcement on high temperature mechanical properties and fracture mechanism of GH3536 deposited by oscillating laser

evidence.quote: The GH3536 pure alloy and nano-WC/GH3536 composite material were fabricated using the circular oscillating laser deposition technique.

nano-sized WC particles were introduced as reinforcement into GH3536 alloy, and a comparison was made between the 25 °C and high-temperature quasi-static tensile properties of the composite and the pure alloy.
This study aims to add 8 % nano-sized WC particles to GH3536 alloys. The corresponding composite materials were fabricated using the ring-swing laser deposition method.

Its average yield strength reaches 533.6 MPa, average fracture strength is 797 MPa, and it has an average fracture elongation of 37.8 %.

samples.original_name: WC/GH3536 composite / nano WC / GH3536 sample

evidence.quote: GH3536 spherical alloy powder (particle size range 53 – 110 μ m) was mixed with 8 % nano-sized WC particles (particle size range 100 – 200 nm) by ball milling for 4 h to obtain the composite powder.
After the addition of 8 % nan-WC particles, a continuous precipitate appears at the grain boundary, which is mainly composed of M6C-shaped carbide.

In comparison, the composite material shows improved performance with an average yield strength of 153.3 MPa, average fracture strength of 165.3 MPa, and an average fracture elongation of 14.98 %. These values surpass those of the pure alloy, and its fracture elongation at 980 ◦ C exceeds its 25 ◦ C performance.
Table 4 Point scan data of nano WC / GH3536 sample corresponding to Fig. 14(b1) (at. %).

At 980 °C, more carbides precipitate on the original carbide network and strengthening it, coupled with better mechanical properties of carbides at high temperatures, making the yield strength, fracture strength and fracture elongation of the composite at high temperatures than the pure GH3536 made by deposition.

The materials were then deposited using the circular oscillation laser with a 1000W power, a feed rate of 780 mm/min, and a 50 % overlap ratio, resulting in block-shaped GH3536 deposition material and WC/GH3536 composite deposition material. Due to the different deposition efficiency, the powder transport rate of pure alloy is about 13.8 g/min, while the powder transport rate of composite is about 6.6 g/min. The deposition thickness of each layer is controlled at about 1 mm, and a total of 8 layers are deposited.
